name: awesome-dynamodb
desc: List of resources for learning about modeling, operating, and using Amazon DynamoDB

resources.name: DynamoDB Office Hours | Online banking service model
The DynamoDB Book
resources.desc: Comprehensive guide to data modeling with DynamoDB. Endorsed by Rick Houlihan and heavily used within Amazon & AWS.

resources.name: AWS re:Invent 2022: Deploy modern and effective data models with DynamoDB
resources.desc: Talk with Alex DeBrie and DynamoDB Principal Engineer Amrith Kumar that covers infrastructure, data modeling, and their interaction.

resources.name: AWS re:Invent 2021: Data Modeling with DynamoDB
resources.desc: Updated talk that discusses core principles with DynamoDB as well as key tips for designing your data model.

resources.name: AWS re:Invent 2018: DynamoDB Under the Hood
resources.desc: Really great talk from a DynamoDB engineer that dives into the architecture behind DynamoDB.

resources.name: AWS re:Invent 2019: Data Modeling with DynamoDB
resources.desc: A more intermediate level talk that will explain some of the principles behind data modeling with DynamoDB.

resources.name: DynamoDB Deep Dive (Course)
resources.desc: A full course from the folks at Pluralsight on how to use DynamoDB.

resources.name: ServerlessConf 2019: Using (and Ignoring) DynamoDB Best Practices with Serverless
resources.desc: This talk focuses on using DynamoDB in Serverless applications.

resources.name: DynamoDB Relationships
resources.desc: A nice 30 minute video series from Gary Jennings that walks through examples of how to model different types of relationships in DynamoDB -- one-to-one, one-to-many, and many-to-many. Nice use of the NoSQL Workbench for DynamoDB as well.

resources.name: Videos from The DynamoDB Book
resources.desc: A playlist of three sample videos from The DynamoDB Book.

resources.name: DynamoDB Best Practices Guide
resources.desc: From the AWS documentation, a list of best practices and examples for modeling with DynamoDB.

resources.name: DynamoDB Guide
resources.desc: A basic walkthrough to DynamoDB concepts, API actions, and mechanics, with some data modeling examples.

resources.name: From relational DB to single DynamoDB table: a step-by-step exploration
resources.desc: Awesome post from Forrest Brazeal with a step-by-step walkthrough of moving to a single-table design.

resources.name: How to switch from RDBMS to DynamoDB in 20 easy steps...
resources.desc: By Jeremy Daly, a funny and eternally useful list of steps for learning how to model with DynamoDB.

resources.name: Comparing multi and single table approaches to designing a DynamoDB data model
resources.desc: Paul Swail takes a look at the pros and cons of modeling with a single table in DynamoDB and provides recommendations on when to avoid it.

resources.name: Lessons learned using Single-table design with DynamoDB and GraphQL in production
resources.desc: A collection of great tips learned the hard way from Rafal Wilinski - Rafal is the creator of Dynobase, listed in the Tools section below.

resources.name: DynamoDB Document client cheatsheet
resources.desc: From the prolific Nader Dabit, this is a handy cheatsheet for using DynamoDB in JavaScript applications.

resources.name: Amazon's DynamoDB — 10 years later
resources.desc: Deep dive into DynamoDB's evolution over 10 years.

resources.name: DynamoDB Examples
resources.desc: An Amazon Web Services and DynamoDB community lead repository containing code and examples for developing with and using Amazon DynamoDB.

resources.name: Amazon DynamoDB Design Patterns
resources.desc: This repo contains sample data models and source code to demonstrate design patterns for Amazon DynamoDB.

resources.name: The Three DynamoDB Limits You Need to Know
resources.desc: Essential guide to understanding DynamoDB's key limitations.

resources.name: Dynoport
resources.desc: A CLI tool that allows you to easily import and export data from a specified DynamoDB table.

resources.name: Dynobase
resources.desc: Handy tool that makes it easy to view and manipulate your tables, generate application code, and more.

resources.name: NoSQL Workbench For Amazon DynamoDB
resources.desc: A tool similar MySQL workbench that lets you model data and interact with your tables without going to the AWS console.

resources.name: DynamoDB Toolbox
resources.desc: An open source project from Jeremy Daly that provides a number of helpful utilities for working with single-table designs in JavaScript. Unofficial winner of the 2019 Best Logo in Open Source award.

resources.name: Dynamoose
resources.desc: An open source modeling tool for Node.js projects, inspired by Mongoose.

resources.name: Dynamode
resources.desc: An open-source strongly typed modeling tool for TypeScript projects.

resources.name: DynamoDB Read Stream
resources.desc: An open-source tool for reading data chunk by chunk. This tool is created for handling DynamoDB limitation for one response (1 MB).

resources.name: DynamoDB Pricing Calculator
resources.desc: Simple tool to calculate your DynamoDB costs.

resources.name: DynamoDB Table Designer
resources.desc: Visual tool to help you create DynamoDB Table definitions without the knowledge of CreateTable syntax.

resources.name: Dynamo Mapper
resources.desc: A simple mapper for converting to and from DynamoDB AttributeValues and Java POJOs using Jackson.

resources.name: Dynoexpr
resources.desc: TypeScript/JavaScript expression builder library which immensely simplifies the DynamoDB.DocumentClient syntax.

resources.name: TypeDORM
resources.desc: Strongly typed object relational mapper built with single-table-design in mind, and inspired by TypeORM.

resources.name: LucidDynamodb
resources.desc: A minimalistic wrapper to AWS DynamoDB.

resources.name: ElectroDB
resources.desc: A DynamoDB library to ease the use of having multiple entities and complex hierarchical relationships in a single DynamoDB table.

resources.name: Alternator
resources.desc: a Scylla feature adding compatibility with Amazon DynamoDB. It can be used locally with Docker or in production.

resources.name: typesafe-dynamodb
resources.desc: Provides type safety and editor type hints to the getItem, putItem, deleteItem and query API (SDK v2) calls which understand the structure of data in your table.

resources.name: SenseDeep
resources.desc: Includes a DynamoDB Studio with single-table aware browser, designer, migration manager, provisioner, and single table metrics.

resources.name: DynamoDB OneTable
resources.desc: DynamoDB library that makes single table designs using Node.js much easier via a high-level type-safe API.

resources.name: Serverless Console
resources.desc: Visual Studio Code extension DynamoDB console.

resources.name: DynamoDB CSV utility
resources.desc: A utility that allows CSV import / export to DynamoDB on the command line.

resources.name: dynaglue
resources.desc: TypeScript library for easily querying and updating against multi-collection/single-table designs.

resources.name: dynamodb-size
resources.desc: JavaScript library for estimating the size of DynamoDB objects.

resources.name: DynamoDataTransform
resources.desc: Dynamo Data Transform is an easy to use data transformation tool for DynamoDB.

resources.name: dynamodb-shell
resources.desc: A simple CLI for DynamoDB modeled on isql and the MySQL CLIs. a simple CLI for DynamoDB modeled on isql, and the MySQL CLIs.

resources.name: NoSQL Architect
resources.desc: A fully automated schema generator and cost optimization tool for single-table designs in DynamoDB.

resources.name: DynamoSharp
resources.desc: An ORM for C# with a focus on single-table design.

resources.name: Dynamo-ts
resources.desc: DynamoDB + TypeScript made simple - An easier way to interact with DynamoDB using TypeScript.

resources.name: Dynomate
resources.desc: Cross-platform DynamoDB GUI client for desktop built with Rust and Tauri. Provides a fast multi-tab UI for browsing tables, running queries, managing items, authenticating with AWS profiles (including SSO & MFA) and more.

resources.name: dynq
resources.desc: An analytic query and data processing CLI tool for DynamoDB that uses jq filters to target, transform, and aggregate items, with automatic pagination, table segmentation, and index expansion.

resources.name: Priority Queuing
resources.desc: This post describes how to convert any of your Amazon DynamoDB tables into a queue that can enqueue and dequeue, as you would do with any other large-scale queuing systems.

resources.name: Near-Real-Time Event Processing
resources.desc: This post evaluates multiple patterns for processing DynamoDB streams by using several AWS services that are part of AWS serverless computing. It also dives into the details about the most reliable and scalable pattern to perform near-real-time processing of DynamoDB streams to notify other systems and users, archive transactions, and replicate data to other data stores while ensuring ordered processing.

resources.name: Advanced Analytics & Visualizations
resources.desc: This blog post shows you how to build a big data pipeline that transitions the data from your DynamoDB table to Amazon S3. This helps you perform advanced analytics by using Amazon Athena, a fully managed Presto query service, and also helps you build visualizations and ad hoc analyses by using Amazon QuickSight.
